name: Koppel
tagline: Share and attach USB devices over the network.
welcomeNote:
It runs as a Windows service and installs the USB driver it needs.
The web interface opens at https://localhost:5240 on this computer.
restartNote: The USB driver is not ready until then, so shared and attached devices may not work.
uninstallNote: Your pairings, keys and settings stay in %ProgramData%\Koppel. Delete that folder to remove them.
